routes.title: Book online
routes.copy: Use the NHS App or NHS website to book routine appointments at a time that suits you — no phone queue, available day and night.

routes.title: Call the surgery
routes.copy: Call {phone} from 8:00am. Tell reception briefly what the problem is — they will make sure the most suitable person sees you.

routes.title: Tell us your symptoms online
routes.copy: Fill in a short online form and a doctor or nurse will review it and reply within one working day with the right next step.

urgentToday: a baby or young child is unwell and you are worried
you have new pain that is getting rapidly worse
a long-term condition has suddenly worsened
you have a temperature that will not come down
emergencyNow: you have signs of a heart attack or stroke
you have heavy bleeding that will not stop
someone has seriously injured themselves or taken an overdose
